title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Morgan Moses (foot) limited Thursday
items.desc: Morgan Moses (foot) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited at another practice on Thursday. He's still managing a foot issue, but it's not likely to leave him sidelined in Week 8, so he should continue to hold things down on the right side of New England's offensive line this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson dealing with an illness
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson was a non-participant on practice due to an illness that he's managing.
items.impact: Henderson missed Thursday's practice, and now we know that it was an illness that left him sidelined. He's likely day-to-day for the time being and seems to have a good chance to suit up and play in Week 8.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Calvin Ridley (hip) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Calvin Ridley (hip) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited for another practice on Thursday, as he's still dealing with a hip issue of some kind. We should know more about his official status for Week 8 after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josiah Trotter (illness) returns to full practice Thursday
items.desc: Josiah Trotter (illness) returned to practice in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Trotter wasn't able to practice on Wednesday due to the illness that he was dealing with, but he returned to practice on Thursday and was a full participant. He should be a full go for Sunday's divisional matchup against the Falcons.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Luke Goedeke (calf) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Luke Goedeke (calf) was absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Goedeke was absent from another practice on Thursday as he continues to manage a lingering calf issue. It looks like he's going to be sidelined in Week 8, which will leave Tampa Bay's offensive front weaker than usual against Atlanta.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kenny Gainwell (hip) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell (hip) was officially limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Gainwell was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday, which was an upgrade after he missed Wednesday's practice with a hip issue. He seems likely to play in Week 8 but will continue to be a depth piece on this offense even if active against the Falcons.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Egbuka was limited again on Thursday as he continues to deal with a pair of injuries. He was able to shed his red non-contact jersey, however, which indicates that he is progressing well at this point. Friday's injury report should give us more clarity on whether or not he will be ready to go in time for Week 8.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Braelon Allen (ankle) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Braelon Allen (ankle) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Allen was upgraded to a full participant on Thursday after being limited by an ankle issue on Wednesday. Fantasy managers should expect him to be startable again if Breece Hall (quad) is ruled out for another game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Bailey (ankle) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: David Bailey (ankle) was absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Bailey was not at New York's practice on Thursday. He's recovering from an ankle issue right now and doesn't seem likely to play in Week 8 as a result. New York's defensive front would suffer if he's unavailable to play this week, especially if Joseph Ossai (ankle) is also out again.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dylan Parham (knee) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Dylan Parham (knee) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Parham was again limited on Thursday as he continues to manage a knee issue that he's been dealing with for a while. He seems likely to suit up and play through it in Week 8, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Hall seems to be drawing near to his return after missing several games with a quad issue. He was still limited on Thursday, however, so it's still possible that he will head into the weekend with an injury designation. Fantasy managers should closely monitor his availability for the rest of the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) returned to Minnesota's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jones returned to practice for the Vikings on Thursday after being sidelined by a knee issue on Wednesday. It remains to be seen whether he was limited or a full participant, but either way this bodes well for his Week 8 availability.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Anthony Gould (concussion) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Anthony Gould (concussion) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Gould seems to be close to clearing the NFL's concussion protocols, as he was able to practice in full on Thursday. He should be good to go for Week 8 but isn't likely to have much fantasy value for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sauce Gardner (calf) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Sauce Gardner (calf) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Gardner missed last week's game while recovering from a calf issue, but it seems likely that he will play in Week 8, as he was able to log a full practice session on Thursday. Indianapolis' secondary will benefit if he's back in the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Warren (groin) limited at practice again Thursday
items.desc: Tyler Warren (groin) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Warren has missed some time while recovering from a groin issue, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion for a second-straight day on Thursday. That's a good sign that he's trending the right way for Week 8, but we won't know his official injury status until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: A hamstring issue left Meyers limited at a second-straight practice on Thursday. He seems likely to play through it in Week 8, however, assuming he suffers no setbacks between now and then.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Allen was a limited participant on Thursday due to the hamstring injury that he continues to battle with. We should get an official injury designation for him sometime after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dylan Sampson (knee) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Dylan Sampson (knee) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Sampson was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited by a knee issue to start the week on Wednesday. He should be a full go for Week 8 and will continue to contribute as a depth option behind Quinshon Judkins moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jared Verse (knee) logs limited practice Thursday
items.desc: Jared Verse (knee) logged a limited practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Verse logged a limited practice session on Thursday after being sidelined by a knee issue on Wednesday. It looks like he's trending the right way for Week 8, which is positive news for the Browns ahead of a divisional matchup against Pittsburgh this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Elgton Jenkins (knee) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Elgton Jenkins (knee) was officially limited at practice on Thursay.
items.impact: Jenkins was back at practice and participated in a full capacity on Thursday. He will likely play in Week 8, which would be good news for Cleveland's offensive front.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Ben Skowronek (calf) was a limited participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Skowronek was limited for another practice session on Thursday. That's a step in the right direction for him, however, as he has missed multiple games due to the calf injury that's bothering him. He remains off of the injury report moving forward, regardless of his health status.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: A.J. Terrell Jr. (groin) limited Thursday
items.desc: A.J. Terrell Jr. (groin) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Terrell was limited for another practice on Thursday as he continues to manage a groin injury of some kind. He should be available to play through it in Week 8, however, which would be good news for the Falcons ahead of a divisional matchup against the Buccaneers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) missed Atlanta's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Robinson missed a second-straight practice on Thursday. He's still recovering from a hamstring injury, and it looks like he's trending towards being sidelined again in Week 8 because of it. Bijan Robinson will see the vast majority of touches out of Atlanta's backfield if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Olamide Zaccheaus (shoulder) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Olamide Zaccheaus (shoulder) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited for another practice on Thursday. He's still managing a shoulder injury, but it looks like he is trending towards playing through it in Week 8, though he will remain a non-factor for fantasy purposes even if active this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jadarian Price (chest) designated to return to practice
items.desc: Jadarian Price (chest) has officially been designated to return to practice for the Seahawks.
items.impact: Price has spent some time on injured reserve while recovering from a chest issue, but the team has officially designated to return, opening up his 21-day practice window. He will be back sometime in the near future, which further complicates the distribution of work in a crowded Seattle backfield.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) officially not practicing Thursday
items.desc: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) is dealing with a knee issue and is officially not practicing for the Patriots on Thursday.
items.impact: Brown has been nursing his ankle issue for a while already, but now he's also dealing with a new knee issue and is not practicing on Thursday because of it. It seems to pose a real threat for his availability for Week 8, and fantasy managers should continue to closely monitor all updates about his health throughout the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Billy Bowman Jr. (hamstring) back at practice Thursday
items.desc: Billy Bowman Jr. was back at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Bowman was sidelined last week for the Falcons and missed practice on Wednesday. He is seemingly on track to return for Week 8 for Atlanta.

items.title: Divine Deablo (forearm) back at practice Thursday
items.desc: Divine Deablo returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Deablo was sidelined last week for the Falcons and missed practice on Wednesday. He is seemingly on track to return for Week 8 for Atlanta.

items.title: Spencer Brown (back) not at practice Thursday
items.desc: Spencer Brown was not at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Brown also missed practice on Wednesday. He will likely need to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play in Sunday's game against the Ravens.

items.desc: Kadyn Proctor is still not practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Proctor has not been able to practice through concussion protocol.

items.title: JuJu Brents (neck/concussion) back at practice Thursday
items.desc: JuJu Brents returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Brents was wearing a red, no-contact jersey as he advances in concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keisean Nixon (shoulder) now questionable Thursday
items.desc: Keisean Nixon is now listed as questionable for Thursday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Nixon was a late addition to the injury report. He'll need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tony Pollard not seen practicing Thursday
items.desc: Tony Pollard was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: It is unclear what the reasoning is for Pollard's absence. He'll need to be monitored on the injury report.

items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) practices Thursday
items.desc: Lamar Jackson practiced again on Thursday.
items.impact: Jackson remains on track to return for Sunday's game against the Bills.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Roquan Smith (knee) back at practice Thursday
items.desc: Roquan Smith returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Smith did not practice on Wednesday. He should be good to go for Sunday's game against the Bills.

items.desc: Jaylinn Hawkins missed practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Hawkins missed a second straight practice. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play in Sunday's game against the Bills.

items.title: Tytus Howard (concussion) not practicing Thursday
items.desc: Tytus Howard missed practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Howard is running out of time to clear concussion protocol in time for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

items.title: Kyle Hamilton (knee) at practice Thursday
items.desc: Kyle Hamilton was at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Hamilton was back on the field after missing practice on Wednesday. It is a good sign for his status for Sunday's game against the Bills.

items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown practiced on Thursday.
items.impact: Brown was not seen during the open portion of practice on Wednesday. His return on Thursday is a good sign for his status for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

items.desc: Vega Ioane returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Ioane missed just one day of practice with a sprained MCL. His status remains uncertain for Sunday's game against the Bills.

items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase was seen in uniform for practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Chase missed practice to begin the week on Wednesday. He'll need to continue to be monitored on the injury report.
